description: 表达式规则引擎核心指标监控，按服务端/客户端两个维度展示

panels.title: 概览

targets.expr: sum(rate(expression_trace_log_index_save_count_total{serviceName=~"$serviceName", businessCode=~"$businessCode", executorCode=~"$executorCode", job=~"$job"}[5m]))

panels.title: 服务端 - 追踪日志写入 QPS

targets.expr: sum(rate(expression_config_query_call_seconds_count{serviceName=~"$serviceName", businessCode=~"$businessCode", executorCode=~"$executorCode", job=~"$job"}[5m]))

panels.title: 客户端 - 配置查询 QPS

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(expression_config_query_call_seconds_bucket{serviceName=~"$serviceName", businessCode=~"$businessCode", executorCode=~"$executorCode", job=~"$job"}[5m])) by (le)) * 1000

panels.title: 客户端 - 配置查询 P95 耗时

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(expression_executor_local_call_seconds_bucket{serviceName=~"$serviceName", businessCode=~"$businessCode", executorCode=~"$executorCode", job=~"$job"}[5m])) by (le)) * 1000

panels.title: 客户端 - 执行器 P95 耗时
服务端指标（追踪日志）

panels.description: 追踪日志索引写入速率，反映规则执行频率

targets.expr: sum by (businessCode, executorCode) (rate(expression_trace_log_index_save_count_total{serviceName=~"$serviceName", businessCode=~"$businessCode", executorCode=~"$executorCode", job=~"$job"}[5m]))

panels.title: 日志写入速率（按 executorCode）

panels.description: 指定时间范围内每个规则组产生的追踪日志总条数

targets.expr: sort_desc(sum by (businessCode, executorCode) (increase(expression_trace_log_index_save_count_total{serviceName=~"$serviceName", businessCode=~"$businessCode", executorCode=~"$executorCode", job=~"$job"}[$__range])))

panels.title: 日志条数（按 executorCode）

panels.description: 最近 1 小时日志写入量 Top 10 规则

targets.expr: sort_desc(topk(10, sum by (businessCode, executorCode) (increase(expression_trace_log_index_save_count_total{serviceName=~"$serviceName", businessCode=~"$businessCode", executorCode=~"$executorCode", job=~"$job"}[1h]))))

panels.title: Top 10 规则（最近 1h 日志量）

panels.description: Top 10 规则日志明细，包含服务名称信息

targets.expr: topk(10, sort_desc(sum by (businessCode, executorCode, serviceName) (increase(expression_trace_log_index_save_count_total{serviceName=~"$serviceName", businessCode=~"$businessCode", executorCode=~"$executorCode", job=~"$job"}[1h]))))

panels.title: Top 10 规则日志明细（含服务名）
追踪日志采集健康（队列丢弃 / 瘦身）

panels.description: 追踪日志待发队列丢弃速率（超过32MB字节预算或队列条数满）。>0 即有日志被丢弃，需关注。客户端与服务端进程都会上报该指标（按 job 区分）。

targets.expr: sum(rate(expression_trace_log_queue_drop_count_total{job=~"$job"}[5m]))

panels.title: 队列丢弃 QPS

panels.description: 丢弃原因拆分：over-byte-budget=超过队列字节预算；queue-full=队列条数满。该指标只有 job/reason 标签。

targets.expr: sum by (reason) (rate(expression_trace_log_queue_drop_count_total{job=~"$job"}[5m]))

panels.title: 队列丢弃趋势（按原因）

panels.description: 采集瘦身跳过速率。原因：function-empty-debug=无调试内容函数行（预期为主）；duplicate-call=重复函数调用；duplicate-snapshot=重复变量快照；detail-row-cap=单追踪明细行数超500。function-empty-debug 为正常瘦身，若 duplicate 激增说明存在循环重复执行。

targets.expr: sum by (reason) (rate(expression_trace_log_sanitize_skip_total{job=~"$job"}[5m]))

panels.title: 采集瘦身跳过趋势（按原因）

panels.description: 时间范围内按原因累计的队列丢弃条数

targets.expr: sort_desc(sum by (reason) (increase(expression_trace_log_queue_drop_count_total{job=~"$job"}[$__range])))

panels.title: 队列丢弃累计（按原因）

panels.description: 时间范围内按原因累计的瘦身跳过条数，可与日志写入量对照估算瘦身比例

targets.expr: sort_desc(sum by (reason) (increase(expression_trace_log_sanitize_skip_total{job=~"$job"}[$__range])))

panels.title: 瘦身跳过累计（按原因）
客户端指标（配置查询 & 执行器）

panels.description: 客户端规则配置查询耗时分布，反映配置获取性能

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.50, sum by (le, businessCode, executorCode, callType) (rate(expression_config_query_call_seconds_bucket{serviceName=~"$serviceName", businessCode=~"$businessCode", executorCode=~"$executorCode", job=~"$job"}[5m]))) * 1000

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, businessCode, executorCode, callType) (rate(expression_config_query_call_seconds_bucket{serviceName=~"$serviceName", businessCode=~"$businessCode", executorCode=~"$executorCode", job=~"$job"}[5m]))) * 1000

histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, businessCode, executorCode, callType) (rate(expression_config_query_call_seconds_bucket{serviceName=~"$serviceName", businessCode=~"$businessCode", executorCode=~"$executorCode", job=~"$job"}[5m]))) * 1000

panels.title: 配置查询耗时分布（按 executorCode）

panels.description: 执行器本地调用耗时分布，反映规则执行性能

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.50, sum by (le, businessCode, executorCode) (rate(expression_executor_local_call_seconds_bucket{serviceName=~"$serviceName", businessCode=~"$businessCode", executorCode=~"$executorCode", job=~"$job"}[5m]))) * 1000

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, businessCode, executorCode) (rate(expression_executor_local_call_seconds_bucket{serviceName=~"$serviceName", businessCode=~"$businessCode", executorCode=~"$executorCode", job=~"$job"}[5m]))) * 1000

histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, businessCode, executorCode) (rate(expression_executor_local_call_seconds_bucket{serviceName=~"$serviceName", businessCode=~"$businessCode", executorCode=~"$executorCode", job=~"$job"}[5m]))) * 1000

panels.title: 执行器本地调用耗时分布（按 executorCode）

panels.description: 客户端配置查询 QPS，反映配置获取频率

targets.expr: sum by (businessCode, executorCode, callType) (rate(expression_config_query_call_seconds_count{serviceName=~"$serviceName", businessCode=~"$businessCode", executorCode=~"$executorCode", job=~"$job"}[5m]))

panels.title: 配置查询 QPS（按 executorCode）

panels.description: 执行器本地调用 QPS，反映规则执行频率

targets.expr: sum by (businessCode, executorCode) (rate(expression_executor_local_call_seconds_count{serviceName=~"$serviceName", businessCode=~"$businessCode", executorCode=~"$executorCode", job=~"$job"}[5m]))

panels.title: 执行器调用 QPS（按 executorCode）

panels.description: 配置查询最慢的 Top 10 规则（按 P95 耗时排序）

targets.expr: sort_desc(topk(10, histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, businessCode, executorCode, callType) (rate(expression_config_query_call_seconds_bucket{serviceName=~"$serviceName", businessCode=~"$businessCode", executorCode=~"$executorCode", job=~"$job"}[5m]))) * 1000))

panels.title: Top 10 最慢规则（P95 配置查询耗时）

panels.description: 执行器本地调用最慢的 Top 10（按 P95 耗时排序）

targets.expr: sort_desc(topk(10, histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, businessCode, executorCode) (rate(expression_executor_local_call_seconds_bucket{serviceName=~"$serviceName", businessCode=~"$businessCode", executorCode=~"$executorCode", job=~"$job"}[5m]))) * 1000))

panels.title: Top 10 最慢执行器（P95 耗时）

panels.description: 配置查询 QPS 按服务名称分组

targets.expr: sum by (serviceName, callType) (rate(expression_config_query_call_seconds_count{serviceName=~"$serviceName", businessCode=~"$businessCode", executorCode=~"$executorCode", job=~"$job"}[5m]))

panels.title: 配置查询 QPS（按 serviceName）

panels.description: 最近 1 小时最活跃的 Top 10 执行器（按调用量排序）

targets.expr: sort_desc(topk(10, sum by (businessCode, executorCode) (increase(expression_executor_local_call_seconds_count{serviceName=~"$serviceName", businessCode=~"$businessCode", executorCode=~"$executorCode", job=~"$job"}[1h]))))

panels.title: Top 10 最活跃执行器（最近 1h 调用量）
慢表达式分析

panels.description: 按慢调用次数排序的 Top 10 慢表达式

targets.expr: sort_desc(topk(10, sum by (businessCode, executorCode, expressionCode, expressionType) (increase(expression_slow_execution_ms_count{serviceName=~"$serviceName", businessCode=~"$businessCode", executorCode=~"$executorCode", job=~"$job"}[$__range]))))

panels.title: Top 10 慢表达式（调用次数）

panels.description: 慢表达式调用频率趋势

targets.expr: sum by (businessCode, executorCode, expressionCode, expressionType) (rate(expression_slow_execution_ms_count{serviceName=~"$serviceName", businessCode=~"$businessCode", executorCode=~"$executorCode", job=~"$job"}[5m]))

panels.title: 慢表达式调用频率趋势

panels.description: 慢表达式明细表，按调用次数排序，avg 耗时 = sum/count

targets.expr: topk(20, sort_desc(sum by (businessCode, executorCode, expressionCode, expressionType) (increase(expression_slow_execution_ms_count{serviceName=~"$serviceName", businessCode=~"$businessCode", executorCode=~"$executorCode", job=~"$job"}[$__range]))))

topk(20, sort_desc(sum by (businessCode, executorCode, expressionCode, expressionType) (increase(expression_slow_execution_ms_sum{serviceName=~"$serviceName", businessCode=~"$businessCode", executorCode=~"$executorCode", job=~"$job"}[$__range]))))

topk(20, sort_desc(max by (businessCode, executorCode, expressionCode, expressionType) (expression_slow_execution_ms_max{serviceName=~"$serviceName", businessCode=~"$businessCode", executorCode=~"$executorCode", job=~"$job"})))

panels.title: 慢表达式明细表

panels.title: Top 10 慢函数（调用次数）

panels.description: 慢函数调用频率趋势

targets.expr: sum by (functionName, groupName) (rate(function_slow_execution_ms_count{serviceName=~"$serviceName", businessCode=~"$businessCode", executorCode=~"$executorCode", job=~"$job"}[5m]))

panels.title: 慢函数调用频率趋势

targets.expr: topk(20, sort_desc(sum by (functionName, groupName) (increase(function_slow_execution_ms_count{serviceName=~"$serviceName", businessCode=~"$businessCode", executorCode=~"$executorCode", job=~"$job"}[$__range]))))

topk(20, sort_desc(sum by (functionName, groupName) (increase(function_slow_execution_ms_sum{serviceName=~"$serviceName", businessCode=~"$businessCode", executorCode=~"$executorCode", job=~"$job"}[$__range]))))
topk(20, sort_desc(max by (functionName, groupName) (function_slow_execution_ms_max{serviceName=~"$serviceName", businessCode=~"$businessCode", executorCode=~"$executorCode", job=~"$job"})))
